commands.summary: Renderer build passed after adding the AndroidOperatorStatus type, the operatorStatus client/fixture, and the AndroidDeviceHealth panel.

36 renderer tests passed, including rendering the device-health panel from the sample bridge status (Online, Android 15/SDK 35, hardware, top activity) and parser unit checks (online vs degraded for ok:false/malformed/incomplete).
Full Electron validation passed: backend build, renderer build, renderer interactions, Node test bundle, and syntax checks.
RepoPact plus ForgeLink local validation passed for the work-item, docs, evidence, and CHANGELOG updates.

environment.process_note: TAURI-008: ForgeLink consumes the Moto One Hyper ROM lab read-only operator-status bridge (rom_lab.forgelink_operator_status.v1). The payload is treated as untrusted, advisory, display-only device status: free-text fields are neutralized for display, ok:false/malformed payloads render as degraded, and nothing in the payload grants authority or triggers actions. There is no live transport yet; the panel renders a clearly-labeled sample of the captured live payload. First consumer is the mobile cockpit surface; a compact desktop Agents mirror is planned.
